details: Warm-up 15 min easy at 7:20-7:50/km, HR 135-145; drills 5 min; 2 x 10 min tempo at 5:50-5:55/km, HR 165-172, with 2 min jog at 7:30-8:00/km; cool-down 10 min easy.
notes: Do not race rep 1. Finish feeling controlled.

details: Run 45 min at 7:15-7:55/km. Finish with 12 min hip, calf, quad, and ankle mobility.
notes: If HR rises above 150, slow down immediately.

details: Pull-ups 4 x 6-8, one-arm rows 3 x 10 each side, rear-delt raises 3 x 15, curls 3 x 12, hangs 2 x 30 sec. Optional 20 min jog at 7:45-8:20/km.
notes: Skip the jog if the knee feels irritated.

details: Bulgarian split squats 3 x 8 each side, RDL 3 x 10, step-ups 3 x 10 each side, glute bridge 3 x 12, hamstring sliders 3 x 10, calf raises 3 x 18. Then 25 min easy at 7:20-7:55/km plus 4 x 20 sec strides at about 4:30-4:40/km with full walk-back.
notes: Leg day is moderate, not maximal.

details: 80 min mostly easy at 7:05-7:40/km. Hold HR 140-150 for the first 70 min. Last 10 min can drift to 6:45-6:55/km only if HR stays 150-155 and the knee feels good.
notes: Do not turn the club into a race.

details: 35 min easy at 7:20-8:00/km. Finish with light quad and calf stretching.
notes: If Saturday felt hard, replace with 40 min walk.

details: Push-ups 4 x 10-15, DB shoulder press or pike push-ups 3 x 10, bench dips 3 x 10, lateral raises 3 x 15, triceps extensions 3 x 12, plank 3 x 45 sec. Add a 30 min walk.
notes: This is a low leg-stress day.

details: Warm-up 15 min easy, drills 5 min, 5 x 3 min at 5K effort 5:15-5:20/km with 2 min jog at 7:30-8:00/km, cool-down 12 min easy.
notes: First two reps should feel like you could do one more.

details: 50 min easy at 7:15-7:55/km plus 12 min mobility.
notes: Stay patient if pace feels slow.

details: Same pull session as last week. Optional 25 min jog at 7:45-8:20/km.
notes: Keep recovery really easy.

details: Leg session: split squats 3 x 8, RDL 3 x 10, step-ups 3 x 10, glute bridge 3 x 12, ham curls 3 x 10, calf raises 3 x 18. Then 30 min easy at 7:20-7:55/km.
notes: No strides this week; save the legs for Saturday.

details: 85 min easy at 7:05-7:40/km. Keep HR 140-150 through 75 min. If all feels smooth, last 10 min at 6:40-6:50/km with HR capped at 155.
notes: You should finish able to jog another 5 min.

details: Brisk walk 40 min. Mobility 15 min focused on calves, hips, glutes, and quads.
notes: Take the non-running recovery day.

details: Repeat upper push session. Add 1 rep per set if last week felt easy. 30 min walk after or later in the day.
notes: Progress upper body, not leg fatigue.

details: Warm-up 15 min easy, drills 5 min, 3 x 8 min threshold at 5:42-5:48/km with 2 min jog, cool-down 12 min easy.
notes: Smooth and even; no sprint finish on reps.

details: 45 min easy at 7:15-7:55/km.
notes: If the legs are heavy, stay closer to 7:45-8:00/km.

details: Repeat upper pull session. Optional 20 min jog at 7:45-8:20/km.
notes: Skip jog if recovery is poor.

details: Leg session as before. Then 25 min easy at 7:20-7:55/km plus 6 x 20 sec strides at about 4:25-4:35/km with full walk-back.
notes: Stay relaxed on strides, not sprinting.

details: 90 min mostly easy at 7:05-7:35/km. Final 10 min may move to 6:35-6:45/km only if HR stays under 156 and knee feels calm.
notes: This is endurance, not threshold.

details: 40 min easy at 7:20-8:00/km. Finish with 8 min stretching.
notes: Cut to 30 min if Saturday lingered in the legs.

details: Repeat upper push. Try to add a small load or 1-2 reps on the first two exercises. Add a 30 min walk.
notes: Upper body progression is the priority today.

details: Warm-up 15 min easy, drills 5 min, 6 x 800m at 5:12-5:18/km pace, meaning 4:10-4:14 per rep, with 90 sec jog recovery, cool-down 12 min easy.
notes: Last rep should be tough but not a death march.

details: 45 min easy at 7:15-7:55/km plus 12 min mobility.
notes: Keep the pace smooth and boring.

details: Repeat upper pull session. Optional 20 min jog at 7:45-8:20/km.
notes: If knee is grumpy, do only the lift.

details: Cut leg volume to 2 sets each: split squats, RDL, glute bridge, calf raises. Then 20 min easy at 7:25-8:00/km plus 4 x 15 sec strides at 4:30/km.
notes: This is a lighter leg day to freshen Saturday.

details: 95 min easy at 7:05-7:35/km. Keep HR 140-152 for most of the run. No fast finish this week.
notes: This is the biggest aerobic day of the block.

details: Brisk walk 45 min. Mobility 15 min.
notes: Use the walk to reduce stiffness, not add fatigue.

details: Repeat upper push. Stop 1-2 reps shy of failure on every set. Add a 30 min walk.
notes: Keep freshness for Tuesday.

details: Warm-up 15 min easy, drills 5 min, 4 x 1km at 5:12-5:16/km with 2 min jog recovery, cool-down 12 min easy.
notes: Rep 1 should feel controlled; do not blast it.

details: 45 min easy at 7:15-7:55/km.
notes: Today is pure aerobic maintenance.

details: Repeat upper pull session. Optional 20 min jog at 7:45-8:20/km.
notes: Keep the jog short and loose if you do it.

details: Moderate leg day: split squats 3 x 6-8, RDL 3 x 8-10, step-ups 2 x 10, glute bridge 2 x 12, calf raises 2 x 18. Then 25 min easy at 7:20-7:55/km.
notes: Reduce load if the knee feels irritated.

details: 80 min easy at 7:05-7:35/km with HR 140-150. No fast finish. This is a cutback long run before the test week.
notes: Finish fresher than the previous Saturdays.

details: 35 min easy at 7:20-8:00/km.
notes: Short and relaxed.

details: Upper push at slightly reduced volume: 3 sets on main exercises, 2 sets accessories, 25 min walk.
notes: Start tapering fatigue this week.

details: Warm-up 15 min easy, drills 5 min, 3 x 400m at 4:58-5:02/km pace, meaning 1:59-2:01 per rep, with full 200m jog recovery, cool-down 12 min easy.
target_hr: Rep HR rises but do not force max effort
notes: This is sharpening, not fitness building.

details: 35 min easy at 7:20-8:00/km.
notes: Keep cadence light and relaxed.

details: 20 min very easy at 7:30-8:05/km, then 4 x 20 sec strides at about 4:30/km with full walk-back. Finish with 12 min mobility.
notes: You should finish feeling restless, not tired.

duration: 55-65 min total including warm-up and cool-down
details: Warm-up 15 min easy at 7:20-7:50/km, drills 5 min, 4 x 20 sec strides, then 5K time trial. Pace plan: km 1 at 5:10, km 2 at 5:08, km 3 at 5:07, km 4 at 5:05, final km all-in if you have it. Cool-down 10 min easy after.
target_hr: Race HR will climb through high 170s into 180+ late
notes: Target band is 25:20 to 25:40. If you feel amazing, push under 25:15.
